FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Title: Foundry Translate
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Name: Foundry Translate
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Label: Configure translator
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Hint: Configure a local or cloud translation provider and verify its availability.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Heading: Translator connection
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Intro: Choose free local translation in Chrome or a cloud provider for this world.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Name: Provider
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Hint: Choose a local or cloud translator.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Chro: Runs directly in desktop Chrome 138 or newer, with no API key and no character limit. Chromium forks such as Helium may not include the required language models.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Goog: Uses the official Google Cloud Translation Basic v2 API and may incur charges.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.ApiKey.Name: Google Cloud API key
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: The key is stored only in this browser on this device.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.SourceLanguag: Keep automatic detection when an adventure combines multiple languages.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.PrivacyChrome: Translation runs locally in the GM browser. Text and names are not sent to Google or another translation service.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.PrivacyGoogle: Requests are sent directly from the GM browser to Google Cloud. The API key is never stored in the world, compendium, or an export.
